fixes.evidence: internal/mcp/server.go:379-382 correctly releases single-call admission after writeAsync returns. However, handleBatch appends responses at lines 412-413 and releases admission at line 415, before queueing the response array at line 419. fixes.gap: The batch path still bypasses admission limits: finished responses accumulate in the batch array after their reservations are released. A large valid 2025-03-26 batch can retain thousands of large replies and exhaust memory. This remains a major gap in P1. Retain release callbacks until writeValue(out) returns; release cancelled calls immediately.
